title: pi-shepherdr: 271-token Pi orchestrator for Herdr multi-agent panes
summary: howaboua pi-shepherdr lets one master Pi agent list, start, watch, send to, and unwatch worker Pi agents in Herdr panes via a 271-token orchestration surface. Blocked workers return exact Herdr CLI commands; install via pi install npm:@howaboua/pi-shepherdr.
question_it_answers: How do I run parallel Pi coding agents in Herdr without a large orchestrator skill?

claims.text: Orchestration surface exposes list, start, watch, send, and unwatch with explicit pane placement.
claims.evidence:
list finds agents and workspaces
- start requires a name and explicit placement: a new workspace, new tab or existing pane
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops

claims.text: Shepherdr deliberately does not focus, move, stop, or close panes; Herdr owns layout lifecycle.
claims.evidence: Shepherdr does not focus, move, stop or close panes. Herdr owns the terminals, layout and session lifecycle.
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops
